findings.F1: The tested result is on the predicted side but well short of the bar: the forecast-weighted excess 7-day return is +1.20 % with t 0.99 over 163 days (409 cases), and the size is +0.30 % (t 0.52, 490 days), or 0.015 of a usual move; this already uses all 19 coins and all four folds, so no more data is available.
findings.F2: On the visible folds B and C, the effect sits only in the larger scaled rises. In the choppy calm profile, weeks with a scaled rise of 0 to 0.5 are followed by -5.7 % excess over 7 days (t -2.77, 26 days, 32 cases). Scaled rises of 0.5 to 1, 1 to 1.5 and above 1.5 are followed by +7.2 % (t 1.79), +7.8 % (t 1.69) and +3.4 % (t 1.40). The forecast terciles agree: low -5.6 % (t -2.77), mid +3.5 % (t 1.01), high +4.2 % (t 1.53).
findings.F3: Across all in-profile bars, the top quintile of the scaled 7-day return is followed by +6.2 % excess over 7 days (t 2.24, 16 days, 29 cases), while quintiles 2 to 4 are at -3.6 % to 0.0 %. The slope of excess return on the scaled rise over the 78 rising cases is +0.060 per unit.
findings.F4: The continuation grows over a longer horizon. For the strategy's signals, the excess return is -0.8 % over 3 days (t -0.84), +0.7 % over 7 days (t 0.30) and +2.9 % over 14 days (t 0.71). Over 14 days, scaled rises of 1 to 1.5 are followed by +27.4 % (t 1.58) and those above 1.5 by +5.2 % (t 2.00, 10 days), against -7.3 % (t -1.94) for rises of 0 to 0.5.
findings.F5: The effect is mixed across periods, so part of it is drowned by the market's own moves. Signal cases earn -8.3 % excess over 7 days in 2018 (t -2.46) and -2.8 % in 2019 (t -1.45), but +2.0 % in 2020 and +7.7 % in 2021 (t 1.62). The top in-profile quintile carries +9.9 % in 2021 (t 2.60) and -0.5 % in 2019.
findings.F6: The book cannot fix this at the tested horizon. The total move per case is +1.26 % against a 0.22 % trade cost, but the unusual move is only 1.3 times that cost, and the book's Calmar is 0.34 against the 0.75 rule.

ideas.idea: In a choppy, calm market, the larger a coin's rise over the past 7 days against its usual daily swing over the past 30 days, the larger its further rise over the next 14 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader who sees a quiet, trendless coin post an unusually large weekly rise should hold the long for two weeks rather than one, since the continuation needs that long to show above the coin's drift.
ideas.name: choppy calm rise, two weeks
